summary: This video covers Day 2 of Season 9 on the Chinese servers, focusing on Vortex boss rankings and Arena meta shifts. Dauntless and Toxin teams remain top picks in early S9 Vortex, while Corrosion setups featuring Rook and Szecedith demonstrate massive damage potential against the boss eggs. Early test server results for the new Necrosis support show team damage exceeding 60 to 70 billion. In Arena, Necrosis and Aura teams continue to dominate the top ranks.
